run_miQCadj.Rd

Fit a two-component mixture model

Fit a two-component mixture model for mitochondrial percentage versus a complexity metric using flexmix.

Usage

run_miQCadj(
  input_obj,
  percent_mt = NULL,
  complexity_column = NULL,
  model_type = "linear",
  exclude_invalid_values = TRUE,
  use_seed = 123,
  add_median_selection = FALSE
)

Arguments

input_obj

Provided input object can either be a Seurat object or a SummarizedExperiment-derived object.

percent_mt

Character Scalar, optional. Metadata column with mitochondrial percentage information. If NULL (default) it will be resolved to percent.mt, if the incoming object is a Seurat object, and to subsets_mito_percent, if the incoming object is a SummarizedExperiment- derived object. If the data uses distinct column names for the mitochondrial percentage information, it should be specified.

complexity_column

Character Scalar, optional. Metadata column with feature information (default) used as predictor variable for fitting the flexmix model. If NULL (default) it will be resolved to nFeature_RNA, if the incoming object is a Seurat object, and to detected, if the provided object is a SummarizedExperiment-derived object. Should be specified, if a distinct metadata column should be used, i.e. UMI counts, or if distinct naming conventions apply to the default columns, i.e. the feature column being called nfeatures. In one-dimensional models ignored for model fitting, but will be required for original post-hoc adjustments.

model_type

Character Scalar. flexmix model type used for fitting the model. Available options are "linear", "one_dimensional", "spline", "polynomial", or "polynomial_raw". Defaults to "linear"

exclude_invalid_values

Logical Scalar. Whether cells with missing or non-finite values in percent_mt or complexity_column should be excluded from model fitting. Defaults to TRUE.

use_seed

Positive Numeric, optional. Seed control for improving reproducibility. Defaults to 123. Set NULL, if no seed should be used.

add_median_selection

Logical Scalar. Whether component classification should be additionally performed based on aggregated low-quality mitochondrial median values. Will only be performed, if model type is spline, polynomial, or polynomial_raw and the number of cells used for fitting the model is at least 50. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A named list containing:

  • flexmix_modelThe model fitted using flexmix.

  • flexmix_datadata.frame with required meta data columns for fitting the model, scores for fitted components, and posterior probabilities for component classifications.

  • model_infoInformation regarding the column names, settings, component selection, and excluded cells when fitting the flexmix model.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
flexmix_model <- run_miQCadj(input_obj = obj)
} # }
